game: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave (Nintendo Switch 2, released 2026-09-17)
about: Glossary of every unit stat, derived combat value and weapon value the game shows, for hover cards and synergy payoffs. `?` marks a value or formula no Fortune's Weave source confirms. Formulas no source publishes are left out or marked `?`; see open_questions. Sources are community tier (criticalhits.com.br, dadsavepoint.com, KeenGamer, thegameswiki.com, fortunesweave.co.uk) because RPG Site and Game8 publish no stats page; Game8 and Fextralife values come through weapons-and-items.json.

rules.rule: Effective = 2x weapon Mt; Effective+ = 3x Mt (also for the Mt behind a gambit).
You double when your AS is at least 4 above the foe's (some players report 5?).
No weapon triangle. Swords: follow-ups deal 1.2x. Axes: every hit deals at least 5. Bows: no counter at range 1 (Mini Bow excepted), Effective+ vs fliers. Gauntlets: extra Avo.
Magic and magic weapons (Levin Sword, firearms) hit Res and Rsl instead of Def and Prt.
Only combat arts spend durability; normal attacks are free.
Build and Mov are not growth stats; the nine growth stats are HP, Str, Mag, Dex, Spd, Def, Res, Lck, Cha.

stats.name: Hit Points
stats.what: Damage the unit can take; at 0 it falls.
stats.matters: Heals are flat: Physic restores 8 HP at range, Recover 30 adjacent. HP buys the extra enemy phase.

stats.name: Strength
stats.what: Raises physical attack power.
stats.matters: About +1? physical damage per hit for each point: Str/Mag +7 from Song of Passion+ is roughly 7 more per hit.

stats.name: Magic
stats.what: Raises magic attack power and magic-based effects such as healing.
stats.formula: Feeds Atk with spells and magic weapons.
stats.matters: Drives spell and Levin Sword damage; class growth modifiers can't make a low-Mag unit a real caster.

stats.name: Dexterity
stats.what: Raises Hit and Crit; also some skill trigger chances.
stats.matters: The accuracy stat: Dex +3 (Sage Advice, Special Dance) lifts Hit and Crit together.

stats.name: Speed
stats.what: Feeds Avo and Attack Speed.
stats.formula: AS = Spd - max(0, total Wt - Bld).
stats.matters: Doubling takes AS 4 over the foe, so Spd +3 turns a near-double into a double.

stats.name: Defense
stats.what: Reduces physical damage taken; feeds Prt.
stats.matters: The base of Prt: Def +7 from Song of Icewater+ is about 7? less from each physical hit.

stats.name: Resistance
stats.what: Reduces magic damage taken; feeds Rsl.
stats.matters: The base of Rsl: Res +3 from Barrier or Protecting Wings is about 3? less from each spell.

stats.name: Luck
stats.what: Mainly lowers the foe's crit chance, through Ddg. Any effect on Hit and Avo is unconfirmed.
stats.matters: Crits deal 3x, so Lck is crit insurance on tanks and lords.

stats.name: Charm
stats.what: Raises the Hit of Gambits; also sets some trigger rates (Stage Directions: Cha / 2 %).
stats.matters: Only matters on battalion carriers and Cha-based triggers; mounted units can't use battalions.

stats.name: Movement
stats.what: Tiles the unit can move per turn; set by class, not a growth stat.
stats.matters: Desert and swamp cost 2? per tile; Kalla Lv 3 gives the army Mov +2 for one turn?

stats.name: Build
stats.what: Cancels equipped weight when Attack Speed is computed; not a growth stat.
stats.formula: AS = Spd - max(0, total Wt - Bld).
stats.matters: Each Bld point cancels 1 Wt over the limit but never adds AS (Giant's Ring Bld +4, Ginji Juice Bld +4).

stats.name: Rating
stats.what: Sum of the unit's base stats, as an overall power gauge.
stats.matters: A rough check only; decide fights from the forecast.

stats.name: Attack
stats.what: Attack power before the target's Prt or Rsl. The status screen splits it into physical (Phys) and magic (Mys?).
stats.formula: Str or Mag + weapon Mt + modifiers?
stats.matters: Atk bonuses add to damage: Great Counter's Atk +3 is about 3? more per enemy-phase hit.

stats.name: Attack Speed
stats.what: Speed after weight; decides follow-up attacks.
stats.formula: AS = Spd - max(0, total Wt - Bld). Weapon, shield and accessory weight all count.
stats.matters: AS 4 over the foe doubles; the foe 4 over you doubles you. Date Juice gives AS +3 for a map.

stats.name: Hit rate
stats.what: Chance an attack connects; built from weapon Hit, Dex and modifiers. The foe's Avo lowers it (formula unpublished).
stats.matters: Arts carry Hit penalties (Deadeye -30), so Hit +10 or +20 auras are what make them land.

stats.name: Avoid
stats.what: Chance to evade a hit; built from Spd, terrain and gear. Gauntlets give extra Avo.
stats.matters: The dodge-tank stat: forest or thicket +30?, Kalla Lv 1 +50. Not the same as Ddg.

stats.name: Critical rate
stats.what: Chance a hit becomes a critical; built from weapon Crit, Dex and skills. The foe's Ddg lowers it (formula unpublished).
stats.matters: Crits deal 3x damage, so Crit +10 changes kill math on bosses.

stats.name: Dodge
stats.what: Critical avoid: lowers the foe's crit chance, not its hit chance. Mostly from Lck.
stats.matters: Crit insurance, not evasion: Ddg +20 doesn't make a unit harder to hit, it stops 3x crits.

stats.name: Protection
stats.what: Effective physical defense: Def plus Shld, gear, class and skill bonuses.
stats.matters: Prt +10 is about 10? less damage from every physical hit while it lasts.

stats.name: Resilience
stats.what: Effective magic defense: Res plus Shld and other bonuses.
stats.matters: Rsl +7 is about 7? less from every spell or magic-weapon hit; mage maps test it.

stats.name: Shield
stats.what: Raises Prt and Rsl together.
stats.matters: Shield items grant Def, not Shld. Shld +3 counts as Prt +3? and Rsl +3? at once.

stats.name: Might
stats.what: Power of a weapon, spell or art; adds to Atk.
stats.matters: Effectiveness multiplies Mt: Hammer's 14 becomes 42 vs armor (Effective+).

stats.name: Weight
stats.what: Weight of a weapon or equipment; anything above Bld comes off AS.
stats.matters: Every point over Bld is -1 AS: one Wt 5 accessory can cost a double.

stats.name: Range
stats.what: Distance a weapon, spell or art reaches.
stats.matters: Bows can't counter at range 1 (Mini Bow excepted); Deadeye reaches 3-5 at Hit -30.

stats.name: Durability
stats.what: How many combat arts a weapon can still use. At 0 it still works, weaker; repair at the Blacksmith.
stats.matters: Normal attacks are free; budget durability for arts on kills.

stats.name: Uses
stats.what: Casts of a spell per battle; refilled before main battles, at Rest Spot meals, feasts or an inn room.
stats.matters: Physic has 5 uses: plan heals per map, not per turn.

stats.name: Authority
stats.what: Skill rank for leading battalions (Theodora's route in Part I). Raised by Tactics Manuals, among others.
stats.matters: Rank abilities are the payoff: Rein at D (adjacent foes Avo -3), Sofia's Healing Order at B.

open_questions: Damage formula: no Fortune's Weave source publishes it. Atk - Prt (physical) and Atk - Rsl (magic) is assumed from 'Prt reduces physical damage' (CH) and 'compare attack power against enemy Protection' (DSP).
Exact Hit, Avo, Crit and Ddg formulas are not published. Fextralife's and Game8's stats pages could not be fetched (robots).
Doubling threshold: AS +4 (fortunesweave.co.uk, CH, local notes) vs 'disputed, +4 or +5' (DSP). The forecast is authoritative.
Shld = Prt and Rsl together comes from one source (CH). Only Miranilla Juice (Shld +3, Ddg +5) and With My Steed (Shld +3, Ddg +30) grant it in local data; shields grant Def.
The magic Atk label on the status screen: CH (Portuguese) gives 'Mys'; the English label is unconfirmed.
Ddg is crit avoid in both sources (CH, DSP). Cai's walkthrough pairs Pray for Safety (Ddg +10) with a dodge tank, which reads it as Avo; Cai data is frozen (D-42).
How Authority rank changes battalion or gambit stats is not documented (TGW-GB: no figures recorded).
RPG Site (main source) has no stats or combat-formula guide as of 2026-10-08.

Terrain values (thicket/forest Avo +30, deep thicket +40, desert and wasteland Avo -20, desert/swamp cost 2) come from pre-launch footage (TGW-CS). Blessing duration (1 turn) is community-reported (LOCAL-01).
